spells.name: Binding Damnation
spells.effect: The target has **^^Strike-last^^** until the start of your next turn.
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

spells.name: Daemonic Speed
spells.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a maximum of 3.
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

spells.name: Spite-tongue Curse
spells.effect: Inflict 3 mortal damage on the target.
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. If the casting attempt is unsuccessful or if the spell is unbound, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster.
